lines.gist: Jeff Bezos earns a surprisingly low salary from Amazon.
Amazon spends millions protecting Bezos each year.
Questioning why Bezos' base salary is so tiny.
Amazon's CEO gets a much higher base salary.
Bezos' salary has remained unchanged for decades.
Asking where Bezos actually derives his wealth.
Bezos owns a large percentage stake in Amazon.
His stock ownership slice is worth billions of dollars.
Earning that stock value on salary alone would take millions of years.
Comparing Amazon's security spending directly against his small salary.
Asking viewers whether they would prefer a paycheck or equity shares.

ending.cta: Paycheck or shares: which would you take?
ending.lastFrame: Balance scale weighing salary check against security car with text asking PAYCHECK OR SHARES?

whyItWorks: Hook with surprising low salary figure creates immediate curiosity about billionaire wealth.
Dynamic side-by-side scale graphics make huge financial comparisons instantly understandable.
Fast visual transitions and sound effects maintain high visual momentum throughout the video.
Ending with an engaging question prompt boosts comment section interaction.
